note: Step playbooks as DATA. A plan can only use the closed step types of friday/steps/types.py. Goal templates are the small prompt of ONE browser-loop step; the safety rules (payment stop, allow-list, injection safety, no account creation, irreversible confirmation) are NOT repeated here: the browser agent policy layer enforces them on every action of every step.

answers.open_site: login_wall=yes|no; location_prompt=yes|no; <one short sentence of what the page shows>
answers.read_results: products separated by ' ; ', each as: title | pack | price in rupees (max 8), or: no_price

goals.open_site: STEP: open and look. The site {host} is open at {start_url}. Look at the page only: do not search, do not log in, do not click anything that changes data. Take one screenshot_proof. Then finish with exactly this result format: login_wall=yes or no (yes only if the content cannot be used without logging in); location_prompt=yes or no (does the page ask for a delivery location); then one short sentence about what the page shows.
goals.search: STEP: search. Search this site for: {query}. Use the site's search box with value_source text:{query}. If the site first asks for a delivery location, set it with the stored fact delivery_area (value_source fact:delivery_area) and pick the matching suggestion; if the site does not accept that area, finish with the result location=not_accepted. If you hit a login wall, finish with login_wall=yes. Stop as soon as search results are visible and finish with the result: results visible. {retry_hint}
goals.read_results: STEP: read the results. Read the product results now visible for: {query}. Take one screenshot_proof. Finish with the products separated by ' ; ' (at most 8), each in the format: title | pack size | price in rupees (for example: Aashirvaad Atta | 5 kg | Rs 289 ; Pillsbury Atta | 5 kg | Rs 262). Use only what the page printed. If no price is visible, finish with the result: no_price. If a login wall hides the prices, finish with login_wall=yes. {retry_hint}
goals.navigate: STEP: go to a section. Go to the part of this site about: {target}. Only open pages; click nothing that changes data. Take one screenshot_proof and finish with one sentence of what you see there. {retry_hint}
goals.fill_preview: STEP: fill and preview. Fill the form for: {target}, using stored facts; ask the user for anything missing. Do NOT submit and do not click the final send button. Take one screenshot_proof and finish with a short list of the fields filled and the name of the button that would send it.
goals.act_confirmed: STEP: one action that cannot be undone: {target}. First show the user exactly what will happen with request_confirmation. Only after their yes do the single final click, then take one screenshot_proof and finish with what the site says.
goals.read_status: STEP: read a status. Find the status of: {target}. Take one screenshot_proof and finish with the status in one sentence (dates and numbers exactly as printed).
goals.login_request: STEP: ask the site for a login code. On the login screen type the user's phone number from the stored fact phone (value_source fact:phone) and press the button that sends the code. Do NOT enter any code now. When the site says a code was sent, finish with the result: code_requested. If the site cannot send a code, finish with the result: no_code.
goals.login_enter: STEP: enter the login code. The code field takes the one-time code with value_source otp. Fill it, then press the verify or continue button. Finish with the result: logged_in=yes if the page now shows the site content or the account, otherwise logged_in=no.

args.target: the current plan and when it ends
